evidence_items.locator: Paragraph beginning Construction of the multi-building campus
evidence_items.explanation: The disclosure places energization within a year of the June 2024 construction start and reports early training and inference workloads by publication. This is material evidence of delivery capability, but covers the initial phase.

The same paragraph specifically reports two operational buildings and six still under construction at the planned 1.2 GW Abilene campus. Contracted portfolio capacity therefore cannot establish completion of that campus.

The reported billable capacity demonstrates operating delivery at company level. The release does not establish that this entire capacity serves OpenAI or completes the expansion described in the claim; the accompanying revenue figure is not used.

unresolved_gaps: No verified full-campus commissioning record for the discussed Abilene expansion was established by the evaluation date.
Core Scientific’s reported capacity was not mapped completely to OpenAI’s requirements through CoreWeave.
The speaker supplies no precise capacity threshold for sufficiency.
No irreversible project failure meeting the early-resolution rule was established.
